lockup.summary: The company, its directors, executives and holders of nearly all its shares agreed not to sell for 180 days after the prospectus date. The lead underwriters can give written permission to sell earlier.

what: BlossomHill is a company testing small-molecule cancer medicines. It has two drugs in human trials and none approved for sale.
risks: It is an early-stage drug company with a short history, no late-stage trials finished and no record of selling products, so its future is hard to judge.
It has lost a lot of money since it began, expects bigger losses ahead, and may never make a profit.
Even after this offering it will need much more money, which could dilute shareholders or force it to delay or cut its drug programs.
